loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (median) has a higher overall score and large variance across windows, suggesting it is less stable for this trend‑dominated series. Candidate C (dba) also shows higher per‑window errors and a larger gap to the best score, making it less reliable in the presence of unstable model rankings. Thus, the mean strategy is the safest choice.
